company.shortDescription: Taffi offers AI-powered personalized styling & shopping software services.
company.description:
Our mission is to empower individuals by providing personalized styling and shopping services through bespoke expert advice that celebrates their individual and authentic styles. Our diverse team and culture are built around integrity, trust, and passion to delight our customers with contemporary styles they are proud to wear.

Taffi is currently fulfilling personalized styling and shopping services for customers in Saudi Arabia, GCC,  MENA, UK and US regions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 98.05% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,320,667 to $10,541,236, a 2.44x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 40 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 63 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
